messages:
kai: Noticed a customer provisional balance go negative after a reconnect+fallback during canary (canary-2026-06). looks like header/sidecar id was lost and ledger later reconciled down. :confused:
liam: Can you paste the short logs / trace id?
kai: trace=session_0ZpX excerpt:
router.INFO: session=session_0ZpX route=us-east-1 -> fallback=eu-west-1 reconnect=true prefetch=true
sidecar.DEBUG: prefetch_toolcall_id=ptc_555
router.DEBUG: outbound_headers: X-Toolcall-Idempotency: (not-set)
ledger.INFO: session=session_0ZpX provisional_add=+36 toolcall=ptc_555 truncated=true
ledger.INFO: session=session_0ZpX reconcile_adjust=-50 reason=dedupe-finalize
ui.DEBUG: provisional_before=+36 provisional_after=-14
chao: Root cause: router rebuilds headers on fallback and we forgot to copy the sidecar prefetch id into the idempotency header. target region created a new toolcall and ledger deduped.
liam: Short-term: API should never return negative provisional. I'll push a server-side clamp on usage response and add an audit flag (billing.correction=true) so console can explain what happened. ETA 1h.
avery: Console: will show 0 for provisional and surface a link: "Billing correction applied during routing retry; view audit". I'll add a lightweight yellow banner.
chao: I'll patch router to forward prefetch_toolcall_id -> X-Toolcall-Idempotency on fallback and add an integration test simulating reconnect+fallback header loss. ETA next canary.
kai: ops-bot fired alert for account=1024 provisional_negative=-14 canary=canary-2026-06
ops-bot: Alert: provisional_balance_negative account=1024 value=-14 tags=[prefetch fallback]
liam: Also adding telemetry metric billing.reconcile.dedupe_count with tags {region, canary} so we can alert on spike.
avery: Once API exposes billing.correction flag, I'll link audit in the banner.
chao: Note: be conservative copying headers only when prefetch=true to avoid accidental header leaks.
liam: Owners: liam (ledger hotfix), chao (router patch), avery (console UI).
kai: Repro steps in PLAT-4110; SRE to replay with prefetch+forced reconnect.
ops-bot: Incident logged PLAT-4110 severity=low state=mitigating
kai: Closing thread; followups in PLAT-4110 and PRs.
